title: Manager, Cloud Engineering
description:
**Manager, Software Engineering – Cloud Engineering**

**Our Company**

Teradata empowers companies to achieve high-impact business outcomes through analytics. With a powerful combination of industry expertise and leading hybrid cloud technologies for data warehousing and big data analytics, Teradata unleashes the potential of great companies. Partnering with top companies around the world, Teradata helps improve customer experience, mitigate risk, drive product innovation, achieve operational excellence, transform finance, and optimize assets. Teradata is recognized by media and industry analysts as a future-focused company for its technological excellence, sustainability, ethics, and business value.

The Teradata culture isn’t just about one kind of person. So many individuals make up who we are, making us that much more unique. It’s what sets apart the dynamic, diverse and collaborative environment that is Teradata. But even as individuals, there’s one thing that we all share — our united goal of making Teradata and our people, the best we can be.

**Our Team**

This position is for a Manager, Software Engineering in the Platform Services team within the Vantage Core – Platform Software organization. The team builds core cloud platform services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and runtime operations of Teradata compute infrastructure across public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud). These highly reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure services are used by multiple engineering teams and enterprise customers.

Key areas of focus include:

* Cloud-native provisioning and lifecycle automation for distributed compute environments.
* Platform services for orchestration, scaling, and configuration management across public cloud platforms.
* Serverless and event-driven automation frameworks for infrastructure workflows.
* Secure and reliable connectivity enablement for cloud-deployed compute systems.

We are looking for a candidate to join our fast-paced and cutting-edge development organization that is on the forefront of our “Teradata Everywhere” strategy.

Teradata Labs, the technology research and development (R&D) organization within Teradata Corporation, has been turning innovative decision support technology into business results for over 30 years. Our R&D team of analytic architects, database developers and engineers work to understand and advance emerging technologies to invent the next wave of cutting-edge analytic data solutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

The position involves leading one or more software engineering teams responsible for the development, integration, functional and performance testing, and fault analysis of our cloud platform services across public cloud environments. The manager will be responsible for:

* Providing and communicating the engineering vision for your team, aligned with the long-term cloud platform strategy.
* Ensuring the timely delivery of committed features.
* Liaising with other engineering teams, project management, and product management, as well as networking, security, and cloud infrastructure teams.
* Mentoring, providing career growth opportunities, satisfying administrative requirements, and maintaining accountability for direct reports.
* Providing engineering leadership in support escalations as needed.
* Partnering with architects and senior technical leaders to drive scalability, reliability, operational efficiency, and developer productivity across the platform.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, empathetic, and creative engineering leader who is ready to participate in an agile team environment and contribute to the success of Teradata. Given our team’s focus on cloud platform solutions, the ideal candidate should have deep hands-on cloud experience on AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.

**Job Functions**

* Manager of an agile development team responsible for Teradata cloud platform services.
* Collaborates with engineering leadership and project management to set the development priorities of the team.
* Holds direct reports accountable for their individual responsibilities, and is accountable to reports for their career growth.
* Performs various administrative functions related to the management of direct reports, including time sheet approvals, leave approvals, promotion applications, etc.
* Identifies areas for improvement and collaborates with leadership on executing plans for positive change within the organization.

**Qualifications**

**Leadership Skills**

* Proven engineering leadership experience, preferably with direct reports.
* Experience working in a fast-paced agile scrum development environment.
* Proven ability to influence technical decisions across teams and drive engineering alignment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep hands-on experience building and operating systems on at least one major public cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Strong programming expertise in Python or similar languages used for infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Extensive experience designing large-scale cloud-native platforms or distributed infrastructure systems.
* Strong understanding of multi-cloud architecture, cloud networking, IAM, service quotas, and multi-region deployments.
* Experience designing infrastructure automation and provisioning systems using cloud APIs, SDKs, and Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Experience building event-driven or serverless platform architectures.
* Strong experience designing highly scalable distributed systems.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience designing multi-cloud platforms or cross-cloud infrastructure services.
* Experience building internal developer platforms or shared infrastructure used across large organizations.
* Experience working with Kubernetes-based platforms or container orchestration systems.
* Experience building large-scale provisioning or orchestration systems.
* Experience with Teradata Vantage.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline with 6+ years of relevant experience.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Here at OCI we’re building the world’s largest AI clusters and we’re the fastest at bringing them to the market. The AI Infrastructure organization at OCI is leading this effort by creating a GPU focused cloud with the latest hardware providing the best performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution by creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a significant impact on our organization's success.
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled distributed systems engineer to scale and optimize AI infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane that provide computing resources to customer AI workloads. You will provide technical leadership to the team and bring clarity to ambiguous problems and come up with innovative solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance our AI infrastructure to deliver exceptional customer experience and peak performance
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop solutions to scale and optimize AI compute infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane with the goal to optimize customer experience and customer workload performance on our AI infrastructure.
* Develop “best-in-class” AI compute infrastructure for our customers by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularized, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored, compliant and reusable.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, operations, and product management, to understand their requirements and design innovative orchestration solutions.
* Mentor junior developers and drive modern software engineering practices like leveraging data/telemetry to make decisions, well-defined interfaces across components, design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, and comprehensive coverage from unit test, integration test and active production monitoring.
* Develop benchmark metrics and automation to drive and track performance and reliability across customer workload and lower infrastructure stack. ­

**Qualifications & Skills**

* BS (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in software development with programming languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, Go, Rust.
* 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services.
* 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and clarity to cross-functional teams and projects while collaborating across stake holders.
* Systematic problem-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive.
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in managing cloud infrastructure with hundreds of thousands of servers.
* Experience in containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience in scheduling high-performance workloads on Kubernetes or Slurm.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

AI Agentic Platform Orchestration, Benchmarking & Unification
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to build, architect, and lead the team behind our next-generation AI Agentic Platform. This platform empowers enterprises to measure ROI on industry-specific agent activity, benchmark AI agents against performance standards, orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows, and unify AI agents seamlessly across diverse platforms and ecosystems.
  
  
As the engineering leader for this strategic product, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong people management skills to deliver a unified control plane for the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape. You will own the technical vision, drive architectural decisions, and grow a high-performing team that ships at the frontier of AI engineering.
  
  
Platform Capabilities You'll Own
  
  

* Industry-Specific ROI Measurement: Build instrumentation, analytics, and reporting frameworks that quantify the business impact of AI agents across verticals such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, and telecom.
* AI Agent Benchmarking: Develop standardized evaluation harnesses, performance scoring, and quality metrics that allow enterprises to compare agents on accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task success.
* Agent Orchestration: Design multi-agent orchestration engines, workflow planners, routing layers, and coordination frameworks that enable agents to collaborate on complex tasks reliably.
* Cross-Platform Agent Unification: Architect a unified abstraction layer, connectors, and protocol adapters (MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants, LangGraph, etc.) so customers can manage agents across vendors and frameworks from a single pane of glass.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Hire, build, and lead a high-caliber engineering team across backend, AI/ML, and platform infrastructure
* Define and own the technical architecture for a multi-tenant, scalable AI agentic platform
* Drive the technical roadmap for orchestration, benchmarking, observability, and unification capabilities
* Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and GTM teams to translate customer needs into shippable engineering outcomes
* Establish engineering best practices for AI agent development, evaluation, safety, and deployment
* Lead architectural reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex distributed systems
* Build robust evaluation frameworks and ROI dashboards that customers and internal teams trust
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency at scale
* Mentor engineers, set growth paths, run performance reviews, and foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture
* Communicate progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3+ years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native platforms
* Hands-on experience building AI/ML or LLM-powered products in production environments
* Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts including planning, tool use, memory, and multi-agent coordination
* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript
* Experience designing APIs, SDKs, and integration platforms used by enterprise customers
* Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining strong engineering talent
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
* Familiarity with emerging agent interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols
* Experience designing LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems (offline evals, A/B testing, golden datasets, judge models)
* Knowledge of observability for AI systems including tracing, telemetry, and cost/quality monitoring
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering at scale
* Background in building analytics, ROI dashboards, or business intelligence tooling for enterprise customers
* Domain experience in one or more verticals (BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, customer support, or sales)
* Familiarity with AI safety, guardrails, and responsible AI frameworks
* Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field

Technical Stack & Tooling
  
  

* Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Java
* AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google APIs
* Agent Protocols: MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants API, function calling, tool use frameworks
* Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Pinecone/Weaviate/Qdrant, Snowflake/BigQuery
* Streaming & Messaging: Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, gRPC
* Cloud & Infra: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker
* Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana

What We're Looking For
  
  

* A builder-leader who can both architect deeply technical systems and grow a high-performing team
* Someone genuinely excited about agentic AI and the future of multi-agent enterprise systems
* A pragmatic decision-maker who can balance innovation, customer value, and engineering excellence
* A strong communicator who can simplify complex AI concepts for diverse audiences
* A coach and mentor who invests in people and builds inclusive, psychologically safe teams

Why Join Us
  
  

* Lead one of the most strategic AI initiatives at the company at the forefront of agentic AI
* Build a category-defining platform that unifies, benchmarks, and orchestrates AI agents across the enterprise
* Shape product and technical strategy alongside senior leadership
* Work with cutting-edge LLMs, agent frameworks, and evaluation tooling
* Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits
* Flexible work culture with strong investment in learning and development

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Principal Engineer - Systems
description:
**About Freshworks:**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead the design and evolution of the enterprise-scale platform architecture that powers Freshworks’ multi-tier SaaS products. This role will define the architecture strategy for a major platform domain, drive modernization initiatives, and establish best practices across service design, reliability, engineering quality, and cost.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, microservices, event-driven design, and large-scale production operations with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities — and remains genuinely hands-on, writing production code and leading deep debugging when it matters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & Strategy**

* Define and own the platform architecture roadmap for your domain, including the target state and a realistic path to it.
* Design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures supporting high-throughput, low-latency, multi-tenant workloads.
* Establish architecture standards, design principles, decision records, and review practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and own build-versus-buy decisions with measurable outcomes.

**Platform Engineering**

* Architect and build cloud-native services and APIs that scale with global growth.
* Design service decomposition, API contracts, messaging and event-driven flows, caching strategies, and database-layer design.
* Treat multi-tenancy as a first-class design concern: isolation models, noisy-neighbour control, per-tenant limits, and cost attribution.
* Lead platform modernization — monolith decomposition, migrations, and deprecations carried through to completion.

**Reliability, Performance & Operations**

* Drive platform reliability, availability, performance optimization, and observability.
* Take ownership of complex production issues in distributed SaaS environments, leading deep root-cause analysis and implementing permanent preventive safeguards.
* Define SLOs, failure modes, resilience patterns, and capacity planning for the systems you own.

**Engineering Excellence & Quality**

* Write clean, maintainable, high-performance production code and build proof-of-concepts that settle architectural questions.
* Establish rigorous engineering standards through code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD integration.
* Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical debt, and drive practical, iterative refactoring without compromising business delivery.

**Security, Privacy & Compliance**

* Ensure platform designs and team practices align with information security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Design for tenant isolation, access control, auditability, and data residency from the outset.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide architectural guidance across multiple engineering teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.
* Mentor senior and staff engineers, raising the bar through reference implementations and sponsorship rather than authority.
* Influence engineering strategy and long-term technology investments; articulate complex trade-offs to both technical panels and executive stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience.
* 14+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or systems architecture within modern distributed SaaS environments.
* Expert-level backend engineering in Java, Python, Go, or equivalent — currently hands-on.
* Proven experience designing and operating enterprise-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, with real numbers for throughput, latency, availability, and behaviour under failure.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency and idempotency, retries and backpressure, concurrency, caching, and database design and optimization.
* Demonstrated ownership of large-scale migrations or modernization initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Advanced production debugging skills — Linux internals, profiling, log analysis, and telemetry in distributed cloud environments.
* Experience leading cross-functional architecture initiatives in SaaS or product organizations.

**Good to Have**

**Data Platform & Analytics**

* Batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, and serving architectures; streaming and CDC (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium).
* Lakehouse and modern data platform technologies such as Delta Lake, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud-native data services.
* Reusable data models, semantic layers, and curated data products enabling self-service analytics.
* Data governance practice — metadata management, cataloging, lineage, and data quality frameworks.
* Feature and training data architectures supporting AI/ML initiatives.

**Adjacent Experience**

* ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or similar analytical and search engines.
* AI-native product capabilities — RAG, agentic workflows, and LLM integration in production.
* FinOps practice: cost attribution, showback, and efficiency guardrails at platform scale.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: IT&D Senior Integration Engineer
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced IT&D Senior Integration Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Azure Integration Services and modern cloud integration patterns. The person will be responsible for designing and delivering scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade integration solutions connecting applications, data, APIs, and business processes across cloud and hybrid environments.This is an invitation to bring your expertise to a place where you can nurture growth, influence progress, and be a driving force in helping us achieve our purpose.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Design and Architect Integration Solutions leveraging Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hub, Functions, Storage, and Event Hub) aligned with enterprise integration patterns and best practices.
  
  
Lead End-to-End Development of scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud-native integration solutions across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  
  
Develop and Manage APIs using Azure API Management, including API lifecycle management, versioning, security policies, throttling, and monitoring.
  
  
Implement Event-Driven and Messaging Solutions using Azure Service Bus, Event Hub, and Azure Functions to support real-time and asynchronous integration scenarios.
  
  
Leverage Agentic AI Capabilities to design intelligent integrations using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Copilot technologies, AI agents, and workflow orchestration to enhance business automation and operational efficiency.
  
  
Design AI-Enabled Integration Patterns that combine traditional integration services with generative AI, intelligent document processing, conversational workflows, and autonomous decision-making capabilities.
  
  
Establish DevOps and CI/CD Practices utilizing Azure DevOps, Git Repositories, Pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (ARM/Bicep/Terraform), automated testing, and deployment strategies.
  
  
Ensure Security, Compliance, and Operational Excellence through implementation of secure coding practices, API security, monitoring, observability, logging, vulnerability remediation, and quality gates.
  
  
Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship to development teams through code reviews, architecture reviews, design guidance, and adoption of integration best practices.
  
  
Collaborate with Business and Technology Stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions and drive successful project delivery.
  
  
Stay Current with Emerging Technologies in Azure Integration Services, Agentic AI, Cloud-Native Architecture, and Modern Integration Patterns, driving innovation and continuous improvement.
  
  
The experience we're looking for
  
  
11-14 years of overall IT experience with 7-10 years of hands-on experience in Azure Integration Services.
  
  
Strong expertise in Logic Apps, API Management, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Infrastructure as Code.
  
  
Good Exposure & hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI, AI Agents, Microsoft Copilot, Agentic AI frameworks, and AI-powered automation.
  
  
Experience in enterprise integration, API-led connectivity, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  
  
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and solution architecture skills.
  
  
The skills for success
  
  
Azure Logic Apps, API Management, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Hub, Event Grid, Azure OpenAI, Copilot, Agentic AI, AI Agents, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Bicep, Microservices, Event-driven Architecture, Integration Architect
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Specialist, MEEHS Solution Architecture
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health & Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Role Overview**
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build-versus-buy options, guide proof-of-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the MEEHS target architecture Develop current-state, transition-state, and target-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.
* Establish trusted information models Define canonical data models, business vocabularies, identifiers, metadata standards, master and reference data alignment, and contextual relationships across projects, facilities, systems, equipment, documents, work processes, risks, and controls.
* Advance digital-thread capabilities Conceptualize and assess digital-thread use cases connecting engineering design, project controls, construction, commissioning and qualification, asset handover, site operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS information.
* Assess feasibility and shape investments Evaluate business value, technical feasibility, architecture fit, data readiness, integration complexity, cybersecurity, compliance, operating impact, cost, vendor capability, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Enable insights and AI readiness Create governed data foundations that support operational dashboards, KPI reporting, predictive insights, AI-assisted search, knowledge retrieval, machine-learning use cases, and future agent-enabled workflows. Design and build visualization layer using Power BI.
* Provide delivery leadership Convert approved concepts into solution designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, data contracts, implementation roadmaps, technical work packages, non-functional requirements, test strategies, deployment plans, and support models.
* Guide platform and vendor decisions Lead technical evaluations of COTS, SaaS, cloud, data, integration, analytics, and AI technologies; assess vendor roadmaps and architecture claims; and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Embed security, privacy, and compliance Incorporate secure-by-design, least-privilege access, identity federation, encryption, logging, monitoring, data classification, privacy, records management, GMP/GxP, validation, and audit-readiness requirements.
* Partner through a product mindset Work with Product Managers to connect user needs and business outcomes to capabilities, roadmaps, backlogs, release increments, adoption measures, product health, value realization, and total cost of ownership.

**What You Should Have**
**Primary Skills**
**TOGAF**

* API Architecture (REST, OData, Web Services)
* Data Architecture (Lakes, Lakehouse, Warehouse)
* Enterprise System Integration

**AI/Machine Learning Architecture**

* Secondary Skills CAD/BIM Platforms (Autodesk, Bentley)
* CMMS / Asset Reliability Platforms
* EHS Platforms (Enablon, Sphera, Cority, Intelex)
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 years of IT experience, including substantial experience in system architecture, solution architecture, enterprise integration, application modernization, and data-platform design.
* Demonstrated experience creating solution, integration, application, data, cloud, security, and deployment architectures for complex enterprise environments.
* Experience designing interoperability across COTS, SaaS, vendor-hosted, cloud, hybrid, and enterprise platforms using reusable integration and information patterns.
* Experience architecting data hubs, data platforms, warehouses, lakes or lakehouses, semantic models, metadata and lineage capabilities, data quality controls, and governed analytical consumption.
* Experience progressing concepts from discovery and feasibility assessment through proof of concept, pilot, implementation, rollout, operational transition, and lifecycle management.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, infrastructure, integration, data and analytics, procurement, service management, vendors, and managed service teams.
* Pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing experience is preferred. Experience in other industrial manufacturing sectors supporting engineering, maintenance, asset reliability, construction, manufacturing operations, or EHS will also be considered.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Architecture methods and modeling Capability mapping, domain architecture, reference architectures, architecture principles, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, design reviews, and modeling approaches such as ArchiMate or UML.
* Integration and interoperability API-first and event-driven architecture; REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OData, webhooks, message queues, event streaming, API gateways, iPaaS, middleware, ETL/ELT, managed file transfer, and data contracts.
* Data architecture and governance Relational and NoSQL models, warehouses, lakes and lakehouses, data products, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata catalogs, lineage, quality, stewardship, retention, archival, and role-based access.
* Cloud and platform architecture Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud services; SaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless services, hybrid integration, network patterns, availability, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, observability, and environment strategy.
* Digital engineering and MEEHS domains Engineering information management, CAD/BIM, project controls, common data environments, asset information, CMMS, condition monitoring, predictive reliability, EHS systems, electronic work permits, risk assessments, project-to-operations handover, digital threads, and digital twins.
* Analytics and AI enablement Power BI or comparable business intelligence platforms, analytical data preparation, feature-ready datasets, vector and semantic retrieval concepts, knowledge graphs, responsible AI controls, data provenance, model monitoring, and human oversight.
* Cybersecurity and identity Zero Trust, secure-by-design, IAM, SSO, MFA, RBAC, PAM, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, certificates, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, threat modeling, audit logging, and secure vendor connectivity.
* Regulated delivery and operations SDLC, Computer System Assurance, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 principles, GMP/GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 concepts, ALCOA+ data integrity, change and release control, traceability, periodic review, incident and problem management, and audit readiness.

**Non-Technical Skills And Competencies**

* Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect business capabilities, processes, applications, integrations, information, technology, controls, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
* Product-centered mindset with a focus on user needs, business value, reusable capabilities, roadmap sequencing, adoption, product health, lifecycle sustainability, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts clearly to business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, quality and security partners, vendors, and senior leadership.
* Ability to facilitate discovery, architecture workshops, trade-off decisions, design reviews, feasibility assessments, and cross-functional alignment using clear decision criteria.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through ambiguity without losing delivery discipline.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage conflicting priorities, constructively challenge assumptions, and build alignment within a global matrix organization.
* Inclusive and collaborative leadership style that invites diverse perspectives, shares knowledge, develops others, and establishes trust across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Certifications**

* TOGAF, ArchiMate, or a comparable enterprise and solution architecture certification.
* Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
* DAMA Certified Data Management Professional, Databricks Data Engineer, or comparable data architecture and governance certification.

**Working Hours and Expectations**

* This is primarily an office-based position. The successful candidate is expected to work on-site a minimum of three days per week to support effective architecture collaboration, stakeholder engagement, design workshops, knowledge sharing, and team development.
* Collaborate across global time zones and provide reasonable overlap for scheduled meetings with manufacturing sites, enterprise teams, vendors, and product stakeholders.
* Participate in planned architecture workshops, proof-of-concept activities, releases, cutovers, disaster-recovery exercises, and occasional off-hours support for critical implementation or production events in accordance with established procedures.
* Occasional travel may be required to support manufacturing sites, project teams, vendor engagements, architecture workshops, or implementation activities.

**Performance Measures**

* Delivery of approved current-state, transition-state, and target-state architectures, reference patterns, architecture decisions, implementation roadmaps, and technical work packages aligned with agreed scope and outcomes.
* Successful interoperability outcomes demonstrated through secure, reliable, supportable, and reusable integrations between platforms and critical enterprise systems.
* Progress in establishing central data hubs with trusted ingestion, transformation, metadata, lineage, quality, semantic modeling, access, and consumption capabilities.
* Business acceptance and measurable use of governed data for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and prioritized AI use cases.
* Feasibility assessments and architecture recommendations that provide clear options, trade-offs, dependencies, cost and risk considerations, and executable next steps.
* Compliance with architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, GMP/GxP, validation, data integrity, records, operational resilience, and audit-readiness requirements.
* Reduction of duplicate integrations, fragmented data flows, unsupported technologies, manual reconciliation, technical debt, vendor dependency, and lifecycle risk through documented architecture actions.
* Consistently demonstrates strong work ethic, ownership, accountability, integrity, and sound judgment while fostering inclusive, respectful, and collaborative behavior, sharing knowledge, seeking diverse perspectives, and contributing positively to cross-functional team outcomes.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing medicines and vaccines for many of the world’s most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to advance innovative health solutions for people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
We seek a pragmatic and forward-looking architect who combines technical depth with product thinking and delivery focus. The successful candidate will be able to move between strategy and implementation, simplify complex ecosystems, establish trusted data foundations, guide cross-functional decisions, and create secure, compliant, interoperable, and sustainable digital capabilities for EHS.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Working at Abbott**
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You will also have access to :
  
  

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit, an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor's degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**About Lingo**
Meet Lingo, a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers such as glucose, ketones, and lactate to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
As Staff Platform Engineer at Lingo, you will spend meaningful time building and operating alongside your team, taking ownership of technically complex platform work while also being responsible for the day-to-day allocation of work, tracking and providing feedback to Platform Engineers at the India location. You set the technical standard your team works to, you unblock them when problems are hard, and you make sure they have the clarity, context, and support to do their best work.
  
  
Azure is our primary cloud platform. You will bring strong hands-on Azure expertise and apply it across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and SRE practices, while developing your two direct reports to grow in the same disciplines.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**

* Own the day-to-day work allocation for your team, ensuring engineers have well-scoped, meaningful work that matches their skills and develops their capabilities.
* Support your team through technical challenges, unblocking complex problems and guiding engineers toward solutions rather than solving everything yourself.
* Build, provision, and maintain Lingo's cloud infrastructure on Azure, taking ownership of technically complex or high-risk platform work alongside your team.
* Own and evolve key areas of Lingo's infrastructure-as-code foundation using Terraform or Bicep, including module design, standards, and code review for your team's contributions.
* Design and maintain CI/CD pipeline architecture for Lingo's engineering teams, defining deployment patterns, environment promotion gates, and release automation standards that your team implements and operates.
* Lead from the front on SRE practices, contributing to SLO and SLI definitions, designing alerting and monitoring configurations, and driving post-incident reviews that generate real engineering improvements.
* Build and maintain observability tooling across Lingo's production environment, covering distributed tracing, log pipelines, and metrics collection, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need.
* Partner with product and feature engineering teams to support their deployment needs, onboard them to platform tooling, and reduce friction in the path from development to production.
* Contribute to architecture and design discussions with the Platform Engineer Lead and Senior Manager, providing practical input grounded in your day-to-day operational experience.
* Document infrastructure, runbooks, and operational processes in a way that supports knowledge sharing across Lingo's globally distributed engineering team spanning the US, Spain, and India.
* Identify process, tooling, and reliability improvements within your team's domain and drive them to completion with appropriate prioritization and stakeholder communication.

**Required Qualifications :**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering with hands-on work in a production environment.
* Strong hands-on Azure expertise, with production experience across Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, and security services.
* Solid infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent, including designing and reviewing reusable modules in a team environment.
* Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent, including deployment automation and environment promotion.
* Working understanding of SRE principles including SLOs, SLIs, alerting strategies, on-call practices, and incident response and post-incident review workflows.
* Experience with observability tooling for monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing in a cloud-native environment.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls including identity and access management, network security configurations, and secrets management.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed engineering team spanning multiple time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure-native services such as Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure Security Center in a production context.
* Experience supporting IoT, biosensor, or real-time consumer health data platforms where data reliability and low-latency processing are critical.
* Familiarity with AIOps tooling and AI-driven observability practices, including anomaly detection and automated alerting.
* Background in MLOps infrastructure, including model serving, feature stores, and pipeline orchestration on cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud security and compliance frameworks including HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI in an engineering context.
* Prior experience in a consumer technology company or high-growth digital health environment.

title: Salesforce Success Architect
description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.
  
  
Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.
  
  
The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
  
  

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude**
We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:
  
  

* Life Sciences Cloud
* Public Sector
* Financial Services Cloud
* Revenue Cloud & Billing
* Manufacturing Cloud
* Automotive Cloud
* Education Cloud
* Net Zero Cloud
* Non-Profit
* Loyalty Cloud

**Basic Requirements**

* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.
* Communication & Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

title: Platform Operations Engineer (Work Timings :- 03:00 AM IST to 11:30 AM IST )
description:
**Job Purpose**
As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you are part of the team responsible for delivering the internal cloud platform that enables our SaaS product teams to build, deploy, and operate reliably in Azure and AWS. This role focuses on building platform capabilities that are reusable, secure, observable, and easy to consume. You will engage in full lifecycle delivery from implementation and automation to hardening, supportability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You’ll be working in an enablement team that treats platform components as versioned products, with stable interfaces, high documentation standards, and a relentless focus on reducing cognitive load and operational friction for R&D, Cloud Security, SRE and Cloud Operations teams. You will collaborate with these users to ensure consistent and efficient use of the platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver modular, secure, and reusable infrastructure components using Terraform, backed by automation pipelines and telemetry.
* Implement platform capabilities such as Kubernetes clusters, ingress, networking, observability, data services, and identity integrations as standardized building blocks.
* Embed operational resilience logging, metrics, alerting as default characteristics of the platform.
* Integrate cloud security and compliance requirements (e.g., IAM boundaries, encryption, audit readiness) into the delivery pipeline in collaboration with the Cloud Security Operations team.
* Develop internal APIs, CLI tools, or service wrappers that simplify infrastructure consumption and improve developer experience.
* Maintain and evolve platform components through versioning, lifecycle policies, and continuous refactoring based on telemetry and platform feedback.
* Providing documentation, usage examples, and onboarding guides is essential to facilitate the adoption of a platform and reduce the support burden. The ability to share knowledge and create comprehensive documentation are fundamental skills for a cloud platform engineer.
* Participate in planning, refinement, and technical review sessions to align with platform architecture and cross-functional delivery priorities.
* Act as a mentor and enabler for the Cloud Operations team members
* Utilize AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

Pay Transparency Notice
  
  
**Role**
Tungsten Automation is committed to fair, consistent, and transparent pay practices, wherever we operate. Before any interview or salary discussion, we disclose the following for this role:
  
  

* Base pay range: For this role, based in India, the base pay range is 3000000-400000 INR, set using objective, gender-neutral and otherwise non-discriminatory job evaluation criteria applied consistently to all employees performing this role or work of equal value.
* Total compensation: This range reflects base pay only. Tungsten Automation may also offer bonuses, commissions, equity, and benefits, described separately where applicable or required by local law.
* How your pay is determined: Your base pay within this range will be based on objective, non-discriminatory factors — such as location, skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and education or training. It will not be reduced based on prior salary, and will not fall below the disclosed range or below what colleagues performing equal work or work of equal value receive.
* Salary history: Tungsten Automation does not ask candidates about current or past pay, and you are not required to disclose it, except where local law expressly permits or requires this.
* Your right to discuss pay: Nothing in this notice limits your right to discuss your own pay, to negotiate, or your entitlement to equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. Tungsten Automation does not retaliate against employees or candidates for discussing compensation.
* Questions: If you have questions about this notice or how pay was determined for this role, contact talent@tungstenautomation.com.

*While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.*
**Required Skills**
**Required Qualifications**

* Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure delivery or platform engineering roles in a cloud-native environment
* Proficient with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices, working knowledge of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
* Experience developing tooling or platform components using a higher-level programming language such as Java, C#, or C++
* Strong understanding of cloud services in Azure and/or AWS
* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with cluster provisioning and workload identity
* Knowledge of securing infrastructure components and implementing policy-as-code.
* Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash)
* Familiarity with observability concepts (logs, metrics, traces) and how to make them first-class in infrastructure
* Strong collaboration and documentation skills; able to deliver structured solutions with a product mindset
* Skills in prompting AI systems and assessing output quality
* Ability to leverage AI to ideate, develop and scale to the needs of the department

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building internal platforms, golden paths, or self-service developer experiences.
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows
* Exposure to policy-as-code frameworks and configuration hardening standards (e.g., CIS benchmarks).
* Experience working in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and integrating compliance into infrastructure delivery.

You think in abstractions, not just scripts. You build for reusability, stability, and clarity knowing that your users are other engineers relying on your work to move faster and safer. title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description:

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
You are a Senior Software Development Engineer L4 who brings strong reporting and data experience to design, build, and optimize scalable systems that power analytics, business intelligence, and reporting capabilities for clients. You work as a senior technical contributor, helping shape architecture, engineering standards, and delivery practices across the team. You use sound judgment, deep technical expertise, and a data-driven mindset to build secure, reliable, high-performance solutions that support business outcomes.

* Discover, review, and influence evolving designs, architecture, and standards for building and delivering services and solutions.

description:

8+ years

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Architect to lead large-scale cloud transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on AWS to Azure migrations and application modernization. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing scalable, secure, and resilient cloud architectures while driving migration strategy, application assessment, and target-state solution design. * Lead cloud assessments, dependency mapping, migration wave planning, cutover planning, and risk mitigation activities.
* Implement monitoring, logging, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies across Azure environments.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance throughout the cloud transformation lifecycle.

* Ability to lead architecture workshops, provide technical guidance, and drive solution design decisions.

description:

**(Please Note-: Only Immediate Joiners will be considered)**
**Position Overview**

* Job Title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer
* Experience Level: 8 to 10 Years
* Work Location: Hyderabad

**Role Description**
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Azure Cloud Engineer**
with strong expertise in Kubernetes (AKS), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and enterprise CI/CD automation. In this role, you will own the Azure Kubernetes Service platform, manage cloud application gateways and ingress routing, drive build and deployment standards, and ensure high availability and security across production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* AKS Platform Ownership & Kubernetes Management

+ Design, provision, maintain, and lifecycle-manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pools, autoscaling policies, upgrades, and disaster recovery/backup-restore procedures.

* Build & Deploy Infrastructure (CI/CD & GitOps)

+ Own end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
+ Standardize Helm charts and artifact management, implementing modern GitOps practices using Argo CD or Flux.

* Azure Application Gateway (WAF) & Ingress Management

+ Configure and maintain Azure Application Gateway with Web Application Firewall (WAF).
+ Integrate AGIC (Application Gateway Ingress Controller) with AKS for Layer 7 routing, SSL/TLS termination, and automated certificate management via Azure Key Vault.

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

+ Author, test, and maintain modular Terraform scripts for provisioned Azure resources, including AKS, Application Gateway, Azure Container Registry (ACR), and networking stack.
+ Enforce reusability, versioning, and policy-driven continuous delivery.

* Container Platform Governance & Standards

+ Establish and enforce container governance: namespace architecture, resource quotas, HPA, Cluster Autoscaler, Pod Disruption Budgets (PDBs), and base image security scanning.

* Release Strategies & Site Reliability

+ Execute blue/green, canary, and rolling deployment strategies with fail-safe rollback mechanisms to guarantee minimal disruption and maximum uptime.

* L3 Incident Management & Troubleshooting

+ Provide top-tier (L3) engineering support for AKS cluster issues, ingress/egress network flows, deployment pipeline failures, and performance bottlenecks.

* Architecture, Documentation & Collaboration

+ Partner with application development teams to facilitate smooth workload onboarding to AKS.
+ Document system architectures, produce operational runbooks, and mentor junior/mid-level engineers on Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code best practices.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
  
  

* Experience: 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure Administration, with a heavy emphasis on Azure.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Proven experience operating production-grade AKS clusters, CNI networking, Helm, and GitOps workflows (Argo CD / Flux).
* IaC & Automation: Proficient in enterprise-grade Terraform module development and Azure CLI/PowerShell scripting.
* Networking & Security: Deep knowledge of Azure Application Gateway, WAF policies, AGIC, Azure Key Vault integration, VNet peering, and private endpoints.
* CI/CD Tools: Mastery of Azure DevOps pipelines, GitHub Actions, Docker image lifecycle, and container registry security.
* Certifications (Preferred):

+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

title: Platform Architect
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Platform Architect**
to define and drive our cloud-native platform strategy. You will be responsible for designing scalable Kubernetes-based platforms, establishing architecture standards, and enabling engineering teams with modern platform capabilities. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will shape the future of our infrastructure while improving developer experience, reliability, and platform adoption
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead end-to-end application onboarding and cloud migration across Azure and GCP, covering requirement gathering, application assessment, NFRs, architecture definition, migration strategy (rehost, replatform, refactor, modernization), implementation, deployment, and transition to operations.
* Design and govern scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-effective cloud architectures across Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes, covering compute, networking, storage, databases, identity, security, observability, and platform services, while ensuring alignment with architecture and governance standards.
* Act as the primary technical architecture and stakeholder point of contact for onboarded applications, collaborating with application owners, business stakeholders, engineering, security, infrastructure, SRE, operations, and cloud providers to resolve technical challenges and ensure successful adoption.
* Own the Business Enablement technical backlog and contribute to the cloud/platform roadmap, including requirements clarification, prioritization, solution definition, dependency management, technical planning, identifying technology gaps and modernization opportunities, and coordinating delivery with engineering teams.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring on Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, cloud migration, application modernization, and platform engineering best practices, while driving continuous improvement, standardization, and adoption of scalable platform capabilities.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* Extensive experience designing enterprise Kubernetes platforms with expert knowledge of Kubernetes and CNCF technologies.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Experience with cloud-native tools such as Helm, ArgoCD, Prometheus, Istio, and Crossplane.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, GitOps, CI/CD, and platform engineering best practices.
* Exposure to AI/ML platform architectures, including deploying and managing AI workloads on Kubernetes, with an understanding of MLOps practices and AI observability.
* Knowledge of scalable AI infrastructure on cloud platforms and emerging AI infrastructure patterns integrated with cloud-native and platform engineering practices.

*Personal competencies*

* Strong technical leadership with the ability to influence engineering decisions.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Collaborative mindset with a passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* Proactive, self-driven, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Adaptable and eager to learn emerging cloud-native technologies.

Who we are
  
  
At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

title: Senior Principal IT Architect
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This role sits within the Infrastructure & Operations organization, supporting the Platform Services team responsible for delivering foundational cloud platforms that enable enterprise technology, research, and business initiatives across Medtronic. The team focuses on cloud architecture, platform engineering, automation, security, and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments.
  
  
The position partners closely with Global Security, Application Services, Enterprise Architecture, and engineering teams to define and implement scalable platform capabilities including cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps automation, and emerging technologies.
  
  
This role is based at the Medtronic facility in Hyderabad, India and follows an onsite work model. Occasional travel may be required based on business needs.
  
  
We are seeking a senior cloud and platform architecture leader to drive the design, governance, automation, and evolution of enterprise cloud platforms across a multi-cloud environment. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic architecture leadership to build secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure solutions that support critical business and healthcare technology initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Define and govern enterprise cloud architecture patterns across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Design and implement Kubernetes-based platform solutions to support scalable and resilient application deployments.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or Ansible.

description:

The position requires an experienced Senior Engineer with a strong focus on cloud native services, AI, Data Engineering, DevOps, Automation and creating reusable platforms. The candidate should have a deep understanding of DevOps/Infrastructure-As-Code (IaC) delivery models, Cloud Network, Security, Application architecture, genAI concepts, data engineering and usage models. The candidate must be experienced with Agile, DevOps and test-oriented system design philosophies, as well as ability to interface with other teams that may need education on cloud & AI best practices.
  
  

* The ideal candidate must be a strong Senior Developer and have experience using AWS services beyond just EC2s and Databases. Expertise in serverless, managed services, API-Governance, Basic Networking is required. Strong coding skills are expected.
* Skilled with AWS Step Functions, JavaScript, NodeJS and Python, especially  APIGW/Lambda and Elastic Beanstalks.

* Lead, mentor, and grow high‑performing Cloud and DevOps engineering teams, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

* Experience with working and building an automated build-pipeline, continuous integration, and continuous deployment. Experience with source code control repositories
