title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Python, Cloud & GenAI)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
  
  
We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity.
  
  
The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact.
  
  
As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity.
  
  
API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership.
  
  
System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures.
  
  
Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards.
  
  
Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication.
  
  
Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads.
  
  
Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs.
  
  
Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles.
  
  
Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery.
  
  
Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns.
  
  
LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization.
  
  
RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality.
  
  
AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks.
  
  
Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management.
  
  
Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  
  
Mentoring & Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs and code, raise engineering quality across the team, and help engineers adopt modern Python, cloud, and AI engineering practices.
  
  
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, platform teams, security, architecture, product management, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
Technical Communication: Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and capabilities to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders with clarity and precision.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Experience: Typically 7+ years of software, platform, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including significant hands-on ownership of production systems and technical architecture. Demonstrated experience building production cloud-native applications on GCP and working with Generative AI or ML systems is required. Experience may span traditional software/platform engineering and newer AI engineering; candidates are not expected to have spent an unrealistic number of years specifically working with Generative AI.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently design complex systems, lead technical execution across multiple engineers or teams, influence architecture, and convert emerging technologies into reliable enterprise capabilities.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong production software engineering fundamentals. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asyncio, pytest, and modern Python tooling. Familiarity with Java, Go, TypeScript, or another production language is advantageous.
  
  
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, API design, distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous programming, software architecture, automated testing, debugging, Git, and engineering best practices.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Build, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns including containerization, serverless, event-driven design, service mesh, autoscaling, and infrastructure as code. Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, inference, and modern foundation-model architectures.
  
  
Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable modern ML/AI frameworks.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience designing and building production applications using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic AI patterns.
  
  
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging for production systems.
  
  
**TransUnion Overview**
At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

**Position Summary**
AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.

title: Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable machine learning and Generative AI solutions supporting clinical, pharmacy, payer, and operational use cases
* Develop predictive models, recommendation systems, NLP solutions, deep learning models, and LLM-based applications to solve complex business problems
* Build and optimize data pipelines, feature engineering workflows, and model training frameworks using large-scale healthcare and business datasets
* Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector search solutions, prompt engineering techniques, and LLM evaluation frameworks
* Fine-tune and deploy foundation models while ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and performance
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps best practices including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, model deployment, experiment tracking, monitoring, and observability
* Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions
* Ensure adherence to Responsible AI principles, data governance standards, HIPAA requirements, and enterprise security controls
* Analyze model performance and continuously improve model accuracy, latency, cost, and user experience through experimentation and optimization
* Provide technical leadership, mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices and standards
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches that create measurable business value
* Support production AI systems through monitoring, issue resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
* 5+ years of professional software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI development experience
* 3+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning solutions in production environments
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases
* Experience developing cloud-native solutions utilizing AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
* Knowledge of MLOps practices including model deployment, monitoring, experiment tracking, and CI/CD automation
* Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, statistical modeling, and model evaluation
* Solid proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or equivalent
* Solid expertise in SQL, data modeling, and large-scale data processing technologies
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Databricks & Snowflake Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Day to Day Job Duties
  
  
Design, build, and maintain Terraform templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks to automate the deployment of Databricks and Snowflake platforms on AWS.
  
  
Deploy and configure Databricks workspaces, account-level settings, workspace networking, cluster policies, service principals, and Unity Catalog environments using Terraform and platform APIs.
  
  
Configure and validate Unity Catalog metastore architecture, catalog/schema structure, external locations, storage credentials, privilege models, and data governance controls.
  
  
Deploy and validate Snowflake accounts, virtual warehouses, databases, schemas, roles, warehouses, resource monitors, and role-based access control (RBAC) configurations.
  
  
Implement secure AWS infrastructure, including VPCs, PrivateLink, security groups, IAM roles, KMS encryption, Secrets Manager, and network segmentation to support Databricks and Snowflake deployments.
  
  
Build CI/CD pipelines to automate environment provisioning, configuration management, testing, and promotion across development, QA, and production environments.
  
  
Perform platform validation and operational readiness testing, including authentication, authorization, networking, connectivity, data access, encryption, monitoring, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  
  
Partner with Cloud Architects, Security Engineers, and Data Platform teams to establish deployment standards, reference architectures, and platform governance controls.
  
  
Troubleshoot infrastructure, connectivity, identity, Unity Catalog, and Snowflake security configuration issues.
  
  
Create reusable deployment accelerators, Terraform modules, platform blueprints, and operational runbooks to support enterprise-scale platform rollouts.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
Minimum 7+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Platform Engineering.
  
  
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform.
  
  
Minimum 5+ years of experience with AWS services, including VPCs, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, networking, and cloud security.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience deploying and administering Databricks on AWS, including workspace deployment, Unity Catalog, cluster policies, service principals, secrets management, and workspace networking.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience deploying and administering Snowflake, including account setup, database architecture, warehouses, RBAC, data sharing, security policies, and resource governance.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or similar tools.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience implementing secure cloud architectures, including encryption, identity management, secrets management, and network isolation.
  
  
Minimum 2+ years of experience developing automation and deployment scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  
  
Experience validating platform readiness, security controls, operational processes, monitoring, logging, and compliance requirements for production deployments.
  
  
Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, infrastructure governance, automated policy enforcement, and security compliance controls.
  
  
Experience working in Agile delivery environments with sprint-based development and stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to lead architecture reviews, deployment planning workshops, and technical validation sessions.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience deploying enterprise Databricks and Snowflake platforms supporting Data Engineering, Analytics, AI/ML, and governance workloads.
  
  
Experience implementing Unity Catalog governance models, multi-workspace architectures, and cross-account AWS deployment patterns.
  
  
Experience configuring Snowflake network policies, private connectivity, SSO integration, SCIM provisioning, and advanced security features.
  
  
Experience supporting regulated financial services, banking, healthcare, or other highly governed environments.
  
  
AWS, Terraform, Databricks, and Snowflake certifications preferred.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Agentforce Success Architect - AMER Shift
description:
**Description**
At Salesforce, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where individuals from all backgrounds are welcomed and valued. We believe that the unique perspectives and skills of diverse candidates greatly contribute to the success of our teams. As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving successful outcomes for our strategic customers by leveraging your technical expertise in data and analytics.
  
  
Data Cloud supports seamless integration with Salesforce Marketing, Sales, and Service Clouds, enabling Customer 360 use cases. This ensures that businesses can unify customer data across all touchpoints, enhancing AI-driven marketing automation, personalized engagement, and predictive customer insights. By powering hyper-personalized experiences and real-time decision-making, Data Cloud helps organizations maximize customer lifetime value and drive business growth.
  
  
Additionally, Data Cloud is the foundation of Agentforce, enabling real-time, intelligent decision-making by centralizing and harmonizing enterprise data. By leveraging Data Cloud, Agentforce can deliver context-aware AI automation, hyper-personalized customer interactions, and predictive insights, driving greater operational efficiency and business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Be a trusted Agentforce + Data Cloud subject-matter expert for the broader Success Architect organization, including how Data Cloud relates to the success of AI

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Lead software architecture and modernization
  
  
Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.
  
  
Stay deeply hands-on in code
  
  
Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.
  
  
Design strong domain models and APIs
  
  
Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.
  
  
Modernize application foundations
  
  
Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.
  
  
Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability
  
  
Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Improve data access and integration design
  
  
Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.
  
  
Raise the bar for code quality and testing
  
  
Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.
  
  
Create reusable engineering patterns
  
  
Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.
  
  
Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution
  
  
Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.
  
  
What This Is Not
  
  
This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
  
  
This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.
  
  
What You Bring
  
  
Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering
  
  
You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.
  
  
Credible hands-on implementation depth
  
  
You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.
  
  
Service transformation and architecture judgment
  
  
You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.
  
  
Production reliability and performance expertise
  
  
You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Software design and refactoring depth
  
  
You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.
  
  
Data and integration depth
  
  
You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.
  
  
Strong testing and code-quality discipline
  
  
You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.
  
  
Principal-level technical leadership
  
  
You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.
  
  
An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering
  
  
You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.
  
  
Bonus Points
  
  
Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.
  
  
Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.
  
  
Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
  
  
Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.
  
  
Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Modernization advances without destabilizing the business
  
  
Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.
  
  
Critical software becomes easier to change
  
  
Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.
  
  
Architecture decisions become executable
  
  
Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.
  
  
Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle
  
  
Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.
  
  
AI expands engineering leverage
  
  
AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.
  
  
Why This Matters
  
  
ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.
  
  
This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

title: Enterprise Application Architect
description:
**Who We Are:**

Leap Metrics is headquartered in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex. We are a data management, healthcare analytics, and AI-driven care management software company founded to improve health outcomes, lower the cost of care, and assist with regulatory compliance. Our software platform,
**Sevida™️**
, stands for “in the service of human lives.”
**We are on a mission to empower healthcare to know enough to serve every life- better.**

We are a company of passionate, experienced technologists, an innovative group of developers, designers, client advocates, and clinicians. Our team has some of the best enterprise software minds in the technology industry.

To learn more about us, please visit our website at http://leapmetrics.io

**Why work for Leap Metrics:**

**MEANINGFUL MISSION**
– Empowering health providers to focus on care

**FULFILLMENT**
– Make an impact by building a meaningful product

**LEADING EDGE TECHNOLOGY**
– Advance your technical skills by working with the latest and most innovative technology

**COMPANY CULTURE**
- Team-oriented, collaborative, supportive, innovative

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on
**Enterprise Application Architect – Full Stack**
who can operate at both the architecture and engineering levels, understand a business problem, design the solution, explain and defend the architectural choices, guide engineers through implementation, and step into the code when necessary.

The right candidate should be comfortable answering not only “How should we build this?”, but also “Why is this the right architecture, what alternatives did we consider, and what are the trade-offs?”

The role requires strong experience across React, Node.js/NestJS, GraphQL, microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka, MongoDB/MySQL, Kubernetes, GCP, authentication/authorization, caching, and modern AI-assisted development.

**What You Will Do:**

* Own end-to-end solution and application architecture for complex SaaS platforms.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable technical designs and architecture blueprints.
* Define application boundaries, modules, services, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment architecture.
* Make and document key architectural decisions, including technology selection and design trade-offs.
* Design systems using modular monolith, microservices and event-driven architectures where appropriate.
* Define GraphQL architecture, including schema design, federation/API composition and service boundaries.
* Design asynchronous workflows and integration patterns using technologies such as Kafka.
* Define data architecture across relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL and MongoDB.
* Define an authentication and authorization architecture using solutions such as Keycloak/OAuth2/and OIDC.
* Design caching strategies using technologies such as Redis.
* Define cloud-native architecture on Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes.
* Address scalability, performance, availability, resilience, observability, security and disaster recovery.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns and engineering best practices.
* Create architecture, sequence, and data-flow diagrams, API specifications, and technical documentation.
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure implementations conform to agreed designs.
* Build prototypes or proofs-of-concept to validate important architectural decisions.
* Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders and engineering teams to refine requirements and identify technical solutions.
* Mentor senior engineers and provide technical direction to development teams.
* Identify and manage technical debt and modernization opportunities.
* Evaluate new technologies and AI capabilities and determine where they provide meaningful business or engineering value.
* Remain hands-on and contribute to critical implementation areas when required.

**Requirements:**

* Approximately 10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant recent responsibility for application or solution architecture.
* Proven experience architecting and building large-scale SaaS/web applications.
* Strong hands-on background in React and Node.js, preferably NestJS and TypeScript.
* Strong understanding of microservices, modular architectures, and Domain-Driven Design principles.
* Strong experience designing event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar technologies.
* Strong experience with GraphQL, including schema design and federated/composed GraphQL architectures.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and API design principles.
* Experience designing solutions using MySQL and MongoDB, including data modeling, indexing and performance considerations.
* Experience with authentication and authorization standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and Keycloak.
* Experience with Redis or comparable distributed caching technologies.
* Strong knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes architecture.
* Significant cloud architecture experience, preferably with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong understanding of scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, observability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Experience defining CI/CD and cloud-native deployment architectures.
* Ability to analyze existing/legacy applications and develop pragmatic modernization strategies.
* Experience creating technical architecture documentation and presenting design decisions to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams.
* Ability to mentor developers and influence technical direction without becoming a bottleneck.

**Architecture Skills needed**
:

The successful candidate should be comfortable making and defending decisions such as:

* Modular monolith vs. microservices.
* Service and domain boundaries.
* Synchronous vs. asynchronous communication.
* REST vs. GraphQL.
* GraphQL federation/schema composition strategies.
* Kafka topics, events, consumers, retries, and idempotency.
* SQL vs. NoSQL data modeling.
* Database ownership across services.
* Authentication and authorization architecture.
* Caching strategies.
* Kubernetes deployment and scaling.
* Resilience, fault tolerance and failure recovery.
* Observability, logging and monitoring.
* API and application security.
* Legacy application modernization and incremental migration strategies.

**AI & Modern Engineering**

* Strong understanding of AI-assisted software development and modern engineering workflows.
* Ability to identify appropriate opportunities for incorporating AI capabilities into applications.
* Experience designing or building AI-enabled applications/platforms is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, RAG, agents, or related AI application patterns is a plus.
* Ability to evaluate AI technologies pragmatically rather than introducing them without a clear use case.

**Nice to Have**

* Healthcare technology experience.
* Experience working with HIPAA-regulated applications or other highly regulated systems.
* Strong exposure to Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
* Python and data engineering experience.
* Experience with Big Data technologies.
* Machine Learning/AI platform experience.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications into modular or service-oriented architectures.
* Experience with performance tuning, load balancing, high availability, and disaster recovery.

**Education**

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

position in

 Rimini Street Inc, HQ : Las Vegas, NV, USA a disruptor in third party ERP support services, established undisputed leadership and as a natural progression, entered India with Rimini Street, India GCC India kick starting operations in
 **Hyderabad** 
 , in 2013 with Global Client Onboarding Services, IT shared services and Global Service Development. In no time, Rimini Street, India GCC started
 **Bengaluru**

 Rimini Street, India GCC gained valuable share in bringing the reputation to Rimini Street Inc of being a global provider of unified support and managed service solutions for enterprise software. Today, Rimini Street, India GCC is a family of about 800\+ full time talented individuals, thanks to the remarkable talent that has supported the expansion.
   

  

 Rimini Street, India has nicely emerged as Global Capability Centre (GCC), and proudly says, “if you are best of the best, you belong to Rimini”. We are on a mission to contribute significantly to our “Rimini ONE” program, a turnkey Rimini Street service program that offers a comprehensive set of unified, integrated services that can run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize your Oracle and SAP ERP, database, and technology software.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Platform \& Orchestration Engineer is a critical new role responsible for designing, building, and operating the durable execution layer that underpins all AI agent workflows in the Agentic AI ERP Platform. This role owns the Restate runtime deployment, Virtual Object patterns, awakeable lifecycle management, audit integration, and the workflow\-as\-data engine that enables runtime\-configurable business processes.
   

  

 This is a foundational hire. The role bridges distributed systems engineering with AI agent architecture, ensuring that multi\-step ERP workflows (spanning hours to weeks) survive crashes, guarantee exactly\-once execution, and maintain SOX\-grade audit trails.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Orchestration Platform (Primary)**
* Deploy, configure, and operate Restate clusters in production Kubernetes environments (multi\-node, cross\-AZ replication, S3 snapshots).
* Design and implement Virtual Object patterns for business entities (invoices, purchase orders, vendors) — each a 'living' durable object with its own state and lifecycle.
* Build awakeable patterns for human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows that can suspend for days and resume on external signals.
* Implement durable timer patterns for non\-event detection (overdue approvals, missing payments, SLA breaches).
* Design idempotency strategies per ERP system to guarantee exactly\-once writes for financial transactions.
* Monitor and optimize Restate performance using the embedded SQL engine, UI, and CLI tooling.
* Manage service versioning and deployment draining to ensure zero\-downtime upgrades of workflow logic.


**Workflow Engine \& Configurability**
* Design and build the workflow\-as\-data engine that enables runtime\-configurable business processes stored as JSON/YAML definitions in PostgreSQL.
* Create parameterized workflow templates for each Rimini Solution (Finance, Procurement, Supplier, Expense, Support) with customer\-adjustable decision points.
* Implement the generic Workflow Engine Virtual Object that interprets workflow definitions at runtime — approval thresholds, routing rules, escalation timing, autonomy tier per step.
* Build the foundation for a future visual workflow designer by ensuring all workflow logic is externalized from compiled code.


**Governance \& Audit Integration**
* Own the OPA (Open Policy Agent) policy\-as\-code layer — write, test, and deploy Rego policies for risk\-tiered autonomy (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH).
* Build the dual\-stream audit bridge: operational logs (OpenTelemetry → Jaeger/Prometheus) and compliance logs (structured records → PostgreSQL with 7\-year retention).
* Ensure every ctx.run() step in Restate handlers produces a corresponding structured audit record capturing who, what, when, authorization decision, and before/after state.
* Implement the circuit breaker hierarchy (rate limiter → cost governor → error rate breaker → objective breaker → kill switch).


**Proactive Agent Infrastructure**
* Implement the four\-layer proactive architecture: Sensing (events/timers/MCP Sampling) → Governance (OPA) → Execution (Restate \+ reactive agents) → Audit (dual\-stream logging).
* Build the 'Self\-Waking Virtual Object' pattern enabling millions of monitoring agents at near\-zero cost through durable sleep.
* Integrate ERP event sources (SAP Event Mesh, Oracle EBS Business Event System) with deterministic filter pipelines.
* Implement trigger recursion detection and prevention ('Did I cause this?' deduplication checks).


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with strong Java or Kotlin proficiency.
* 3\+ years working with distributed systems — event sourcing, state machines, message queues, or workflow engines.
* Production experience with at least one durable execution or workflow orchestration platform (Temporal, Restate, AWS Step Functions, Cadence, Conductor, Camunda, or similar).
* Hands\-on Kubernetes experience — deploying StatefulSets, managing persistent storage, configuring operators.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or cloud\-native event services).
* Understanding of exactly\-once semantics, idempotency patterns, and distributed transaction strategies (Saga, compensating transactions).
* Experience implementing audit logging and compliance controls in regulated environments (SOX, SOC 2, GDPR) is strongly preferred.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Core platform language and framework — must be proficient.Java 21 / Quarkus:
* Durable execution platforms — production experience with either; willingness to become Restate expert.Restate or Temporal:
* Cluster operations, Helm charts, operators, StatefulSets, persistent volumes, pod affinity/anti\-affinity.Kubernetes:
* Audit tables, structured compliance logging, query optimization.PostgreSQL:
* Policy\-as\-code authoring and testing (or strong willingness to learn).OPA / Rego:
* Distributed tracing instrumentation, span creation, context propagation.OpenTelemetry:
* Kafka or equivalent — producing/consuming events, partitioning, consumer groups.Event Streaming:
* Understanding embedded storage (Restate's internal store) — helpful but not required. RocksDB:


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, JD Edwards) — even basic familiarity is valuable.
* DBOS Transact experience (PostgreSQL\-based durable execution — our fallback option).
* Workflow engine design — building configurable workflow definitions, visual builders, or BPM\-style tools.
* AI/LLM integration — understanding agent loops, tool calling patterns, non\-deterministic execution flows.
* Redis — caching patterns for permission manifests and OPA policy evaluation results.
* Grafana / Prometheus — building operational dashboards for workflow health monitoring.
* Air\-gap deployment experience — self\-hostable architectures without cloud dependencies.


**Why Rimini Street?**
 We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top\-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.
   

  

 Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

+ We dream big and innovate boldly.

* Community

title: Staff SW Engineer - Integration
description:
Candescent is the leading cloud\-based digital banking solutions provider for financial institutions. We are transforming digital banking with intelligent, cloud\-powered solutions that connect account opening, digital banking, and branch experiences for financial institutions. Our advanced technology and developer tools enable seamless, differentiated customer journeys that elevate trust, service, and innovation. Success here requires flexibility in a fast\-paced environment, a client\-first mindset, and a commitment to delivering consistent, reliable results as part of a performance\-driven, values\-led team. With team members around the world, Candescent is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 Staff Engineer \- Integrations
   

  

 Experience : 11 Years \- 15
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Reports to: Director, Integrations Engineering
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 Candescent is transforming digital banking with a modern, AI\-powered platform that empowers financial institutions to deliver smarter, faster, and more personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 The Staff Engineer will be responsible for the Integration Platform supporting critical banking and financial services workloads. Deep experience integrating with card and core banking processors (FiServ, Visa, FIS) is needed. This role requires strong expertise in Spring Boot, Spring WebFlux, Netty, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native deployment on Kubernetes. The Staff Engineer will contribute to solution design, drive high\-quality engineering practices, and ensure reliability, performance, and scalability of the integration platform.
   

  

 In addition to core engineering responsibilities, the Staff Engineer will mentor junior engineers, improve code quality and testing standards, own end\-to\-end delivery of features, and support production operations by triaging and resolving issues to maintain high customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Take full ownership of requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, and deployment of integration services.
* Manage end\-to\-end delivery life cycle including production readiness, monitoring, and support.
* Ensure that features and services delivered by the team meet performance, reliability, and security expectations.
* Maintain accountability for addressing production issues, driving RCAs, and implementing long\-term fixes.
* Design and develop integration services using Spring Boot, WebFlux, Netty, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Contribute to architectural discussions and ensure solutions follow best practices for scalability and maintainability.
* Support modernization of existing integration components into cloud\-native, reactive architectures.
* Collaborate with SRE and operations teams to improve system reliability, observability, and operational workflows.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to secure coding and engineering best practices.
* Improve developer productivity through tools, automation, and CI/CD pipeline enhancements.
* Promote the adoption of observability, proactive monitoring, and automated quality checks.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers on design patterns, testing, debugging, and production readiness.
* Contribute to cross\-team design reviews and technical discussions with product, QA, DevOps, and architecture teams.
* Assist in evaluating technical risks and ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements.


 Requirements (Must\-Have)
   

  

* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience.
* Strong proficiency in:
+ Spring Boot, Spring WebFlux, reactive programming
+ Netty, Reactor, non\-blocking I/O
+ REST APIs and microservices
+ Distributed systems fundamentals
+ Kubernetes, Docker, containers
+ Cloud platforms (GCP/AWS/Azure)

* Good understanding of JVM internals, GC logs, thread dumps, and performance profiling tools.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps practices, and tools like ArgoCD.
* Hands\-on experience with logs, metrics, traces, and troubleshooting production incidents.
* Deep understanding of banking domain integration patterns (onboarding, KYC, transaction flows, core banking interfaces).
* Integration experience with core banking and card processors is required.
* Awareness of security and compliance requirements (OAuth2, mTLS, encryption, audit, data privacy, regulatory controls).
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work across engineering, product, and operations teams.
* Strong sense of accountability, ownership, and structured problem\-solving capability.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with distributed tracing tools (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin).
* Familiarity with APM tools such as Dynatrace, New Relic, or AppDynamics.
* Exposure to high\-throughput systems (\>500 TPS).
* Experience with Resilience4j, API gateways, or service mesh architectures.
* Knowledge of caching frameworks like Redis or Hazelcast.
* Contributions to internal frameworks, reusable libraries, or open\-source software.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.
